claim: Silver in c-Si modules is associated with cell semiconductor metallization; one study measured 630 g/t
source_title: Recycling WEEE: Extraction and concentration of silver from waste crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules
conditions: Waste c-Si modules; Ag mapping and quantification; XRF characterization; study-specific feed
reported_result: Average Ag 630 g/t; fine printed threads reported around 100 micrometre width
limitation: Study feed and module generation are not Agastya feed; reported recovery route is not dry electrostatic
relevance: Ag occurrence and separate literature benchmark

claim: Published c-Si module estimates include 300–500 ppm Ag; Ag remains associated with Si-based matrix after delamination and comminution
source_title: Rethinking silver recovery pathways in end-of-life photovoltaic recycling using froth flotation
conditions: Delaminated cells from waste panels; 3.5 kg crushed feed homogenized; d100 2 mm before wet milling; d80 103 micrometre after grinding
reported_result: Rougher flotation in tap water: 97.55 ± 0.03% Ag recovery and 32.2 ± 2.3 upgrade; rougher-cleaner example ~47 wt% Ag at 86.5% recovery
limitation: Bench flotation, reagents used, study feed; not an electrostatic prediction
relevance: Silver-focused comparator and particle/feed design reference

claim: Thermal softening and peel response depend on temperature; experimental coupon conditions provide a replication reference
source_title: Effect of Temperature on the Glass Delamination in End-of-Life of Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Panels
conditions: 370 Wp mono module; six 15x15 cm coupons per condition; 100 or 140 C for 60 min; manual peel about 45 degrees and 20–30 N
reported_result: Different residue and failure morphologies between conditions
limitation: One module family and oven/manual peel setup; not a hot-knife setpoint or general module response
relevance: Stage 1/2 interface pretreatment and validation study design

claim: Full-size PV delamination has been modeled with cohesive-zone elements
source_title: Numerical simulation of the delamination behavior of photovoltaic modules
conditions: Full-size module cohesive-zone modeling; cell dimensions and inter-cell spacing studied
reported_result: Simulation identifies preferential delamination sites and geometry effects
limitation: Not validated for Agastya interface, thermal process, or material parameters
relevance: Supports CZM as a candidate physical model class

claim: An electrostatic PV waste study measured Si grade/recovery, not an Ag product
source_title: Recycling Si in waste crystalline silicon photovoltaic panels after mechanical crushing by electrostatic separation
conditions: Crushed PV powder 0.30–0.45 mm; 15 kV and 30 rpm reported best for Si
limitation: Metric is silicon separation, not Ag recovery; specific feed and separator
relevance: Stage 3 technical comparator; does not justify Ag recovery claim

claim: One c-Si composition scenario gives a component inventory and leaves some mass unassigned
source_title: Recycling c-Si PV Modules: A Review, a Proposed Energy Model and a Manufacturing Comparison
source_type: Review reproducing a literature composition scenario
conditions: Composition breakdown cited for a c-Si panel scenario
reported_result: 72 wt% glass, 15% Al, 7% EVA/backsheet, 2.5% Si, 0.8% Cu, 0.03% Ag, 0.1% Sn, 0.1% Pb; sum 97.53%
limitation: Not a universal BOM or measured Agastya panel; 2.47% remainder unidentified

claim: Crush-and-sieve can enrich Ag in fine fractions, but results are feed/category-specific
source_title: A facile crush-and-sieve treatment for recycling end-of-life photovoltaics
conditions: Mechanical crushing and size classification of study PV feed
reported_result: Up to 70% and 80% total Ag in finest fraction for two feed categories (paper abstract)
limitation: Different study feed and feed category; does not establish Agastya partition or product grade
relevance: Size-classification comparator and Stage 2 feed prep

claim: MOOSE supports coupled thermal-mechanical solution and cohesive-zone interfaces
source_title: MOOSE official coupled thermo-mechanical and cohesive-zone documentation
conditions: General heat transfer and solid mechanics documentation/tutorial
reported_result: Heat equation, coupled thermo-mechanics, cohesive-zone traction-separation capability documented
limitation: Software feature does not provide Agastya-specific material/interface properties or validation
relevance: Candidate engine for Stage 3 pretreatment mechanics if installed

claim: Ansys Rocky documents particle dynamics and Maxwell electromagnetic coupling
conditions: Product capability statement; entitlement depends on license
reported_result: Describes electromagnetic-field particle effects and Maxwell coupling
limitation: Does not confirm availability in a particular student license or data-transfer workflow
relevance: Candidate for Stage 2/3 if exact entitlement verified

claim: XRF determines elemental concentrations in the method scope; PV powders require matrix-specific validation
source_title: SW-846 Method 6200: Field Portable X-Ray Fluorescence
conditions: Portable XRF method written for soil and sediment
reported_result: Includes Ag among analytes; describes XRF elemental concentration workflow
limitation: Method scope is soil/sediment and cannot be assumed validated for PV laminate/powder matrix
relevance: Stage 4 screening candidate only; calibration/matrix validation required

claim: ICP-OES is a determinative elemental measurement method
conditions: Multielement determinations in prepared sample solutions
limitation: Solid PV material requires suitable sample digestion and matrix-specific method performance
relevance: Candidate confirmatory assay after lab-validated sample preparation

claim: ICP-MS determines elemental concentrations in waste extracts/digests after appropriate sample preparation
conditions: Water samples and waste extracts/digests; acid digestion required for total acid-leachable elements in solid wastes
reported_result: Method describes sub-microgram-per-liter solution determinations for many elements including Ag
limitation: Solution detection limit does not directly specify solid-sample detection limit; digestion recovery and matrix require validation
relevance: Candidate bulk Ag quantification method after representative sampling and lab preparation

claim: An Indian public research institute lists a c-Si PV recycling technology and technology-transfer EOI
source_title: Expression of Interest (EOI) and Transfer of Technology
authors: Centre for Materials for Electronics Technology (C-MET)
conditions: Public technology-transfer EOI with stated final date 31 December 2026
reported_result: Technology described for end-of-life crystalline-silicon solar panels
limitation: No Agastya sample supply, facility access or test agreement confirmed
